research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AirGarage is focused on developing systems for managing parking facilities. Their research includes tools for vehicle detection and identification, utilizing methods to control and manage free-flowing parking environments. This involves accurately recognizing vehicles by predicting their paths to capture images at optimal times and locations. These innovations aim to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of parking operations.

overview_description.description:
AirGarage replaces broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. 

We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more. 

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners.

We're on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with the 26% of the median American urban core that is dedicated to parking.

The physical world is full of inefficiencies and better-managed real estate means better cities for all of us living in them.

about_short_description.short_description: AirGarage is the operating system for parking real estate.

product.name: Dynamic Pricing System
product.description: Automatically adjusts parking rates based on real-time occupancy to optimize revenue and traffic flow.

product.name: License Plate Recognition (LPR) Enforcement
product.description: Uses LPR cameras to track vehicles entering and exiting, ensuring compliance and enabling swift enforcement of parking rules.

product.name: Parking Payment Platform
product.description: A web and mobile platform that enables drivers to pay for parking quickly and securely without physical hardware.

product.name: Parking Data & Analytics
product.description: Provides real-time insights and reports on parking usage, occupancy, and revenue to help optimize parking asset management.

product.name: Local Operations Management
product.description: Manages on-site parking facility operations including maintenance, cleaning, landscaping, and issue resolution.

product.name: Marketing and Online Integration
product.description: Enhances online visibility of parking properties and manages rate and availability across booking platforms to increase revenue.
